dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses MCPDATA/MCPAREA copy members typical of ORCA middleware
evidence: no EXEC CICS / no EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt) online submission system; handles online receipt (onrece) data import for the JMA ORCA medical billing system
purpose.summary: ORCBM550 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that reads CSV/parameter files containing online insurance claim (receipt) data and loads them into the ORCA database. It parses command-line parameters, opens DB connections via MCP middleware, reads patient and claim body records, and manages job-step control.

notable_features: COPY members for ORCA-specific layouts (CPONRECE-BODY.INC, CPONRECE-KANRI.INC, CPSK1009.INC, CPJOBKANRI.INC)
MCP middleware DB access (MCPDATA.INC, MCPAREA) instead of EXEC SQL
UNSTRING of comma-delimited COMMAND-PARAM for up to 20 file arguments
OCCURS 50000 table for receipt body records (TBL-ONRECE-B-AREA)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM passed via USING
LINE SEQUENTIAL file organization for CSV/parameter input
